complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Setup Design Tokens and CSS Variables

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Separate into HTML structure setup, asset loading/preconnect hints, semantic/accessibility features, and Shopify-specific integrations.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Involves Shopify-specific liquid templating, accessibility (skip-link), and asset optimization. Moderate complexity from ensuring compatibility and removing theme defaults, but well-defined with pseudo-code.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Create SVG Icon Set and Snippets
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Create individual subtasks for each icon type (cart, menu, search, etc.) with parameter handling, accessibility attributes, and optimization checks.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Repetitive SVG snippet creation with parameters and accessibility. Low complexity as it's mechanical with currentColor inheritance and aria-hidden; scales easily but no interdependencies.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into Liquid template structure, CSS styling/animations, image handling (primary/secondary/hover), info section with price render, and badge logic.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Involves responsive aspect ratios, hover transitions, lazy loading, AVIF, and reusable price snippet integration. Moderate-high complexity from image logic, hover states, and full-card clickability.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into price logic (regular/sale/compare-at), semantic markup/microdata, variant range handling, and currency localization.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Conditional Liquid logic for pricing states, money filters, and SEO microdata. Moderate due to variant handling and semantic requirements, but straightforward Shopify patterns.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break into Liquid schema/template, desktop/mobile layouts, sticky scroll JS Web Component, mobile drawer animation, and cart/search integrations.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Combines Liquid schema, responsive layouts, JS Web Component for scroll/sticky, drawer animations, and Shopify linklists/cart badge. High complexity from multiple interactions and states.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Separate into individual API methods (add/update/get/clear), error handling/custom events, debouncing/CSRF, and Promise-based async patterns.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: ES6 module with multiple Shopify AJAX endpoints, Promise handling, custom events, error states, and debouncing. High complexity from async operations, error resilience, and event system.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into Liquid rendering, CSS animations/styling, JS Web Component (open/close/update), quantity selectors with AJAX, free shipping bar, and empty state.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Integrates Liquid, CSS animations, JS Web Component, CartAPI dependency, real-time updates, progress bar logic, and responsive drawer. Very high complexity from multiple interdependent systems.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into column layouts/newsletter form, linklist rendering, social/payment icons, and responsive grid/CSS.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: CSS Grid responsive layout, newsletter form, multiple linklists, and schema blocks. Moderate complexity from multi-column responsive design and form handling.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Build Hero Video Section for Homepage

complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Video autoplay/loop with fallbacks, full-vh responsive, schema, and mobile image swap. Moderate-high from media handling, browser compatibility, and performance considerations.

complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Simple CSS Grid 50/50 split with reverse/mobile stack, schema, and lazy loading. Low-moderate complexity as it's mostly layout and conditional rendering.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break into grid layout/product rendering, filter UI (desktop/mobile), AJAX Section Rendering API, lifestyle breaks, pagination/sort, and empty states.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Complex AJAX filtering with Shopify API, responsive filters/drawer, lifestyle inserts, pagination, and URL updates. Very high complexity from dynamic content and no-reload UX.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Final Integration, Testing, and Launch Preparation
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Create subtasks for template JSON assembly, performance optimizations, cross-browser testing, accessibility audit, user flow testing, visual regression, and deployment prep.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Orchestrates all prior work with comprehensive testing (Lighthouse, a11y, flows), optimizations, and deployment. Highest complexity due to dependencies, breadth of validation, and integration risks.
